summary: A roughly two-acre lawn and green space at 450 Mission Bay Boulevard South in Mission Bay (per SF Rec & Park's facility page), part of the city's Mission Bay Parks system; the San Francisco Recreation and Park Department assumed management and maintenance on July 1, 2023 (SF Rec & Park). No source checked gives this lawn's own original construction or opening date.

milestones.text: Park P16 -- one of the completed eastern segments (P16 and P17) of the Mission Bay Commons strip in OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update legend, between 3rd St and Terry Francois Blvd; which of the two this record's mapped lawn is, is not confirmed -- described in a Nov 2011 EPA release as "the newest segment of the Mission Bay Commons Park system" and "recently completed" as of this date, funded partly by a DTSC brownfields grant

open_questions: The only dated event found is SF Rec & Park's July 1, 2023 assumption of management from OCII, which is a management transfer, not a construction-completion date -- not used as a completion milestone, per Pier & Point's rule against attributing an area-wide/administrative event to an individual record's build status.

As of 2026-09-22, OCII's own Nov 2024 CAC map places labels P16 and P17 specifically at the east end of the Mission Bay Commons strip (between 3rd St and Terry Francois Blvd), matching this record's own mapped lawn -- resolving which OCII labels apply here, versus the P11/P12/P13/P15 labels used for the separate, still-interim area further west (the Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west) record). The only dated source found (a Nov 2011 EPA press release) names just P16, not P17, and says the park was "recently completed" rather than giving a construction date or a dedication date -- so the milestone above is deliberately narrower than that OCII grouping might suggest.

The EPA release (2011-11-04) names P16 only and has no location; the location of P16 and P17 comes from OCII's Nov 2024 deck legend, and this record's mapped shape leaves the P-number unconfirmed, so the milestone is stated about the eastern Commons segments, not this exact lawn.
